// Part: room: wing walkway. A one-cell-wide gallery (x49, z63..74) over the living room, entered from the lobby at z62,
// with doors into B6 (x50 z66) and B7 (x50 z72). Every cell from z63 to z72 is a lane, so nothing stands in it: the
// light hangs overhead on chains (2-high clear below), and the one piece of furniture sits in the dead end at z74
// where the entry looks down the walk: a reading lectern, with its stand cell at z73 left clear.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
import { porchLantern } from "../vocab/h2.mjs";

const X = 49;
const Y_FLOOR = 11; // stand row; the floor is y10
const Y_CEIL = 16; // top air row; the plate is y17

export function build(g) {
  // Lanterns hang from chains off the plate, one over z64, z69 and the lectern at z74. None sits over a doorway cell
  // (z62, z66, z72): the lane under each is 2 high and clear.
  for (const z of [64, 69, 74]) porchLantern(g, X, Y_CEIL, z);

  // The focal piece: a lectern at the dead end (z74) facing north, toward the walk and the entry.
  // Rows run along z from z63 to z74 (one column, x49); the lectern is the only furniture.
  const legend = { L: ["lectern", { facing: "north", has_book: "true" }] };
  const rows = [
    ".", // z63 lane
    ".", // z64 lane (lantern above)
    ".", // z65
    ".", // z66 doorway B6 beside it
    ".", // z67
    ".", // z68
    ".", // z69 lane (lantern above)
    ".", // z70
    ".", // z71
    ".", // z72 doorway B7 beside it
    ".", // z73 stand cell for the lectern
    "L", // z74 dead end
  ];
  layers(g, [X, Y_FLOOR, 63], legend, rows);
}

input.summary:
Wing walkway (parts/room-25.mjs) now lays no blocks: every cell of its column (x49, y11..16, z63..74) is air the mansion shell carved, and runParts locks air too, so the lanterns and lectern were refused.
make.sh runs whole and the walkway line shows 0 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE. Those 7 refused writes were removed.
The roof reports OFF-PALETTE blocks, which are in roof.json (not this part) and were left alone.
left: The walkway's design is not built: no ceiling lanterns on chains at z64, z69, z74 and no reading lectern at z74. The lock blocks them because the shell owns all 72 walkway cells as air.

A fix needs the shell or another part, not this module: the shell would have to leave x49 (or part of the walkway) un-carved, or a later part would have to place light and the lectern on cells it can own.

make.sh still reports OFF-PALETTE for the roof (tuff_brick_slab, tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, tuff_brick_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_stairs, stone_brick_slab). That is in roof.json and is outside this part's scope.
The unused layers/porchLantern imports and the unused g parameter are gone or left as-is in an empty build(g) stub; the file is a no-op by design.

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned each walkway cell, by hand. I had to infer that the shell's box() carve (x38..57, z62..74, y3..17) is what blocks x49, then confirm it.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls: a full make.sh with MCD_PARTS_CELLS, then a node one-liner over the 516 KB cells dump to count owned cells in the column.
waste.tool: runParts should print, for each REFUSED cell, which earlier part owns it (e.g. 'owned by mansion shell: air carve'), and report a per-part 'fully locked footprint' line. That would have pointed at the shell carve on the first run.

waste.what: Checking whether a footprint is writable before writing, one cell at a time.
waste.cost: one make.sh run per fix attempt, about 2 full builds and roughly 4 minutes each.
waste.tool: A pre-flight command such as `mcd plan --owned <part>` (or a lock dump) that lists a room's footprint cells already owned by earlier parts, so a part can check its box before any writes.

companions.task: Hang the walkway lanterns on chains (x49, y15..16 at z64, z69, z74) once the shell leaves the lane's air open for them, and check the 2-high clear under each.
Place the reading lectern at the dead end (x49 y11 z74, facing north) with its stand cell at z73 kept clear, after the shell's wing interior is changed.
